title: Rise Hackathon 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 85 attendees for this first-of-its-kind Hackathon for our club.
The requested budget of INR 38,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Hackathon.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
